title: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose you have read a book recently and intend to recommend it to other members of your book club via an online forum. Briefly introduce the book and explain why it is worth reading. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: I'd like to recommend a book that truly moved me to all of you in our book club. It is Everything I Never Told You, written by Celeste Ng. The novel tells the story of a mixed-race family struggling with expectations, silence and the search for who they really are. There are two reasons why I think it is worth reading. First, what impressed me most is how the book makes you rethink the way we express love and expectations within a family. It taught me that unspoken pressure can hurt the people we care about, instead of simply being an "interesting" story. What's more, the characters' loneliness and quiet struggles feel so real, which makes the novel easy to relate to, and the plain, honest language never gets boring. If you are looking for a book that touches your heart and makes you think, I highly recommend that you give it a read. I'm sure it will stay with you, and I'd love to hear your thoughts on the forum.
keyPoints: 一句点题＋一句概括。落实第 1 段功能：首句 "I'd like to recommend a book that truly moved me" 套用『开篇荐书』句架直接点题；接着 "written by Celeste Ng" 与 "tells the story of a mixed-race family" 给齐书名、作者、内容三要素，完成 Briefly introduce the book，且只一句概括、 不剧透。书名 Everything I Never Told You 以斜体意涵的首字母大写规范呈现。

两理由各配细节。落实第 2 段功能与『分点·理由配细节』方法："First... what impressed me most" 与 "What's more..." 分出两个理由，分别配 "taught me that unspoken pressure can hurt the people we care about" 和 "easy to relate to" 的具体说明，并用 "instead of simply being an "interesting" story" 主动避开空泛夸赞，正面回答 why it is worth reading。

呼吁＋邀交流收尾。落实第 3 段功能："I highly recommend that you give it a read" 用地 道表达发出呼吁，"I'd love to hear your thoughts on the forum" 邀请书友交流，扣回 recommend it to other members of your book club via an online forum 的论坛荐书情境，收束干净。
